objective: Improve real historical net-account return and stability, not another interface-only release. Publish tested new signal code, experiment driver and all results to main through a PR, without enabling orders or merging previously blocked defective accounting.
hypothesis: The equal-dollar ETH/BTC ratio retains common-market exposure when ETH beta to BTC differs from one. Separate persistent idiosyncratic movement from this exposure using strictly lagged beta, and size the hedge at each new episode. This may reduce risk or remove genuine profits; both outcomes must be retained.
source_interpretation: 2025 beta research reports low stability and limited hedging effectiveness, not a promise this strategy works. Our 30/90-day two-asset hourly experiment is NOT replication of its broad-universe annual beta test. No claim of cointegration, statistical arbitrage or exact beta neutrality.
data: Exact previously verified BTC/ETH traded/mark/funding snapshot in artifact9991153959, run34039211921. No source prices, dates or marks are changed. All economic years have already been examined; this is not pristine out-of-sample. Funding is paid/received by held contracts only and is never a prediction feature.
beta: OLS covariance(ETHlogreturn,BTClogreturn)/variance(BTClogreturn), trailing720 or2160 completed hours and then lagged one hour. Require positive finite BTC variance>1e-12; clip raw beta to[0.25,3]. Main shrink=.5*clipped_beta+.5*1. This is a fixed stabilizer, not a fitted Bayesian estimator. No outlier returns or price bars are removed.
residual_signal: At each hour epsilon=ETHlogreturn - lagged_beta*BTClogreturn; no subtraction of fitted intercept. Sum the last720 epsilons divided by std(last168epsilons)*sqrt720. These are lagged-factor innovations, not ex-post refits of the past with a future beta. EntryabsZ>=1.5, exitabsZ<.25 or direction reversal or after720 signalhours. Beta hedge is frozen at signal entry; no same-state pyramiding/rehedging.
